left.raw_text:
Any subject newly implanted according to the most recent guidelines from the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) for less than10 days with:
       -  a Single Chamber  [OR] (SR) or a Dual Chamber (DR) pacemaker from Microport CRM S

right.raw_text:
-  any right atrial  [OR] and/or right ventricular XFINE lead
  2

left.raw_text:
Have reviewed, signed and dated the informed consent
Exclusion Criteria:
  1

right.raw_text:
Included in another clinical study that could confound the results of this study such as studies involving intra-cardiac device
  2

left.raw_text:
Contraindication to a maximum single dose of 310 µg Dexamethasone Sodium Phosphate (DSP)
  3

Tricuspid valvular disease  [OR] or tricuspid replacement heart valve (mechanical  [OR] or tissue) only for subject with DR pacemaker
  4

right.raw_text:
Active myocarditis, pocket  [OR] and/or lead infection
  5

left.raw_text:
Age less than 18 years old or under guardianship or kept in detention
  6

Known pregnancy, women breastfeeding  [OR] or in childbearing age without an adequate contraceptive method
  8

right.raw_text: Be unavailable for the scheduled follow-up associated with this clinical study or refusal to cooperate
